$comment: Mandatory maintainer parity interprets integer as a JSON-decoded Python value whose exact type is int; floats such as 1.0 and booleans are rejected before runtime mutations. The only helper-only structural exceptions are authorization composite uniqueness, canonical replacement-predicate order, parallel-pair strict sortedness, parallel-pair composite uniqueness, task_worktree canonical/symlink-resolved path validation, slice revision-history contiguity, and revision-history length equality with revision_epoch - 1; each has an explicit schema-parity counterexample.
title: Spec-work workflow state

entries.$comment: helper-only exception 1 of 7: the runtime enforces unique composite (slice_id, role) authorization keys; Draft 2020-12 uniqueItems cannot express projected-key uniqueness without changing this compact representation.

parallel_assessments.$comment: Helper-only exceptions 3 and 4 of 7: the runtime requires strict left_slice < right_slice ordering and unique composite (left_slice, right_slice) keys; Draft 2020-12 cannot express those cross-field/order constraints in this compact representation.

blockers.$comment: Canonical blockers use BLK-NNN except for the two closed semantic Pro handoffs BLK-PRO-UNCERTAIN-SEND and BLK-PRO-INVALID-RESPONSE-EXHAUSTED. No generic BLK-PRO namespace is admitted.

updated_at.$comment: The schema carries lexical and date-time annotations. Mandatory maintainer parity reuses the runtime's explicit RFC3339 predicate: Gregorian year 0001-9999, hour 00-23, minute/second 00-59, offset hour 00-23 and minute 00-59, lowercase t/z and fractional seconds accepted, leap seconds rejected. Arbitrary external validators may treat format as annotation-only or vary by interpreter.

planning.$comment: The runtime additionally enforces latest-response selection, digest/commit chain continuity, globally monotonic unique epochs, and accepted binding equality after replaying applicability history.

response_digest.description: Exact response-byte hash; values may repeat because evidence array order identifies occurrences.

required_base_sha.$comment: Runtime validation requires required_base_sha to differ from base_sha; Draft 2020-12 cannot compare sibling string values.

replacement_predicates.$comment: Helper-only exception 2 of 7: runtime validation requires the canonical subsequence order of the supported predicate vocabulary; Draft 2020-12 cannot express arbitrary ordered subsets without duplicating every accepted combination.

task_worktree.$comment: Helper-only exception 5 of 7: JSON Schema requires only an absolute-looking task_worktree path. Runtime validation remains authoritative for canonical and symlink-resolved filesystem identity because Draft 2020-12 cannot resolve host paths.

revision_history.$comment: Helper-only exceptions 6 and 7 of 7: runtime validation requires one-based contiguous revision_epoch values and exactly revision_epoch - 1 archived entries. Draft 2020-12 cannot compare sibling numeric values with array item values or array length.
